h: פָּרָשַׁת כִּי תֵצֵא, ז׳ Ki Seitzei, 7
Levi’s Song and the Holiness Shared by All Israel

p: the zemer for the Shabbos night meal
based on what is said in the Tikkunim
(תִּיקּוּן יח, נה, ב; בִּדְפוּס וִילְנָא לד, א)
and this is the lower Shechinah,
which is from the left side,
there is a change in the prayer,
the holiness of all the meals is one,
of HaKadosh Baruch Hu and His Shechinah";
which is not so on Shabbos:
that of the holy Field of Apples;
is from the side of the Levi'im,
כְּמוֹ דְּאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג קעו, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 176b):
So why does it say here
is from the side of the Levi'im
and not from the side of the Kohen?
that the three meals of Shabbos
for it says in the holy Zohar:
And of the holiness of the three Avos,
from the side of the Kohen,
corresponds to the holiness of the Levi'im,
for the attribute of Gevurah and fear,
which is to the left side,
as is written in the holy Zohar;
and Yaakov, who is called Yisrael,
corresponds to the holiness of Yisrael.
At first glance it appears from this
that the holiness of Avraham and Yitzchak
is greater than the holiness of Yaakov;
the attribute of love of Hashem Yisbarach,
in that he made himself free
one who does not make himself free
and therefore Yishmael came from him,
and made himself free for Hashem Yisbarach,
and is called "the Fear of Yitzchak,"
there is still dross in this:
who does not make himself free
Which is not so of Yaakov,
and he did not feel at all
and there was no dross in it at all.
And so the holiness of Yisrael
also the holiness of Levi and Kohen,
"A city in which there is everything":
And so of the Levi'im it is written (Bamidbar 8:6):
from among the Children of Yisrael,"
from among the Children of Yisrael,
and the Levi'im shall be Mine."
from among the Children of Yisrael."
And so in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 176b):
to be dedicated to Hashem constantly,
For in truth at the Giving of the Torah
would be in the aspect of kohanim,
only to the service of Hashem Yisbarach,
as it will be in the future,
"And you shall be called the kohanim of Hashem,
in the affairs of this world,
from among the Children of Yisrael,
free only for the service of Hashem Yisbarach,
and not be occupied at all
with the affairs of this world;
and they would have no portion in the Land,
only "I am your portion and your inheritance."
they are called in the holy Zohar:
are like Shabbosos and Yamim Tovim."
(as is written in Tanna d'Vei Eliyahu);
from among the Children of Yisrael," etc.,
corresponding to the five books of the Torah"
(as Rashi writes from the Midrash Rabbah);
and why specifically in this pasuk?
Rather, in the place where it is mentioned
from among the Children of Yisrael,
He mentioned also the holiness of Yisrael,
that their holiness is lesser than the Levi'im;
in which "the Children of Yisrael" are mentioned
corresponding to the five books of the Torah.
And so in the words of
רַק בְּאַהֲרֹן כְּתִיב (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א כג, יג)
Only of Aharon is it written (Divrei HaYamim I 23:13):
And the first meal of Shabbos
is arranged in the holy Zohar
Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
Therefore we say in the prayer,
and the Tikkunim cited above say,
that is, the attribute of Malchus,
for this was the purpose of
the making of heaven and earth,
and to Him is one of them"
this is the Shabbos day for Yisrael
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר תַּנָּא דְּבֵי אֵלִיָּהוּ פֶּרֶק א)
that there be a Jewish nation
that will recognize the power of His kingship.
For she is from the left side:
which is the aspect of purity:
to purify "the fool's heart at his left"
and to empty the evil out of it.
into "the wise heart at his right,"
for the Kohen is from the side of Chessed,
And the Levi'im are from the left side,
And regarding Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
"And she saw him, that he was good";
that at the moment he was born
the house was filled with light:
it is written here "that he was good,"
Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
Which is not so of Aharon,
"What did this people do to you,
that you have brought upon it
"And with Aharon Hashem was very angry," etc.;
"Better that the offense be hung on me
A parable of a king's son, etc.:
And this is what the verse says (Vayikra 9:7):
that he was full of shame,
and be a kohen who atones;
that Yisrael are bound at the root;
and this corresponds to the attribute of
Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
"and His service is in silence, etc."
And the Levi'im are to the left side,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמַר בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג לט, א)
as is said in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 39a);
and therefore he opened the zemer
with the words "I will sing praises."
